metadata.summary: Continuous scalp EEG recordings from 23 pediatric patients (24 recordings) with intractable seizures at Boston Children's Hospital; 916+ hours, 23-channel, 256 Hz, 198 expert-annotated seizure events with onset times.
metadata.purpose: Benchmark for epileptic seizure detection and prediction from EEG.
creators: Children's Hospital Boston (now Boston Children's Hospital)

modality.scope: scalp EEG for epileptic seizure detection

ethics.privacy_measures: Data de-identified per HIPAA Safe Harbor; no protected health information included.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.
pending_verification: The following LLM fields were auto-dropped for violating schema constraints and reverted to baseline; pending manual review: medical_fields[list-items], source_type

known_limitations: Labels are event-level (seizure onset), not frame-wise or dense annotations
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Not representative of adult epilepsy, generalized epilepsy without intractability, or non-US healthcare settings.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Only pediatric patients from a single US tertiary center; no reported sex, ethnicity, or socioeconomic subgroup breakdown.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Frame-wise segmentation, classification of non-seizure EEG patterns (e.g., interictal spikes) without additional annotation

data_origin.selection_rationale: Pediatric patients with intractable seizures admitted to a tertiary epilepsy center.

population.missing_groups: Adults, geriatric patients, non-pediatric epilepsy subtypes, diverse geographic/ethnic populations

annotation.labeling_provenance: Expert-annotated seizure onset times; labels are per-recording event marks, not dense frame-wise.
